candidate_ref: current working tree frontend-static resolved-target containment implementation

source_documents.role: The implementation retains lexical rejection, canonicalizes root and targets, and reads canonical in-root targets.
The real Loader composition exercises in-root aliases, outside symlink or junction targets, missing outside children, index-link rejection, and preserved HTTP behavior.
The package contract documents canonical resolved-target containment, explicit 404 misses, and the application-level threat model.
The change is attributed as an active upstream-package-change.

findings.summary: The server now resolves the dist root, requested target, and configured index before reading; an outside resolved target returns 403 and no outside bytes reach the response.
findings.limitations: The portable application check narrows the resolve-to-read race but is not a kernel-grade guarantee against a concurrent filesystem attacker.

findings.summary: The real Loader composition serves an in-root alias, rejects an outside directory alias and its missing child, rejects a parent alias, rejects an outside configured index, and preserves the existing HTTP and teardown assertions.

resolution_sequence: Retain the lexical path check for traversal before filesystem resolution.
Resolve the dist root and requested target with fs.realpath.
For ENOENT or ENOTDIR, resolve the deepest existing ancestor and restore the missing suffix.
Compare canonical paths with relative-path containment and return 403 for resolved escapes.
Read the canonical target and pass a canonical index path to the renderer.
fixtures: An in-root directory alias serves its regular file with 200 and expected bytes.
An outside directory symlink or Windows junction returns 403 with an empty body.
An outside missing child returns 403 rather than an in-root 404.
A link to the dist parent returns 403, proving the exact parent boundary is rejected.
An outside configured index returns 403 for both / and /index.html before HTML bytes are read.
implementation.threat_model: This is trusted-host application containment for build inputs; the repository accepts the residual concurrent replacement race described by the existing cross-family filesystem containment precedent.

decision.result: AAA-013:A02 PASS — resolved-target containment implemented and verified
decision.diagnosis: The lexical-only escape is closed by canonical root and target containment, and the real-composition suite proves both permitted in-root aliases and denied outside targets.
decision.next_action: Complete AAA-013 and advance to the next independent task while preserving the pending AAA-008 and AAA-009 maintainer decisions.
